name: Dining salon — coordinated interior views
prompt:
Create ONE finely detailed interior reference board, INT-R03 — CELEBRATION DINING SALON / COORDINATED VIEWS. Four views of ONE room, plus one small north-up PLAN. GEN-26 is the sole supplied source: preserve its ivory/rose-veined marble, gold floral/star tracery, indigo-star ceiling panels, pointed glazed bays, warm garden flowers. That source does not show a dining salon, so label this room PROPOSED. Do not reproduce its throne, library shelving or conservatory pool. No kitchen or service room. Furnish at HUMAN scale, with clear circulation, not an oversized ceremonial table.
FIXED PROPOSED PLAN: room 24m E-W by16m N-S, apex12m. Exactly ONE oval table centred at x0,y0, long axis north-south, size2m wide x4.2m long x0.76m high. Table is modular: straight centre2.2m long plus two rounded end modules1m long each. Exactly8 dining chairs: three on each long side and one at each end. Seat height0.48m. Exactly THREE tall pointed window bays on EAST wall at y=-5,0,+5; blue and rose glass. Exactly ONE double entrance centred on SOUTH wall. NORTH wall has a shallow central pointed apse and one fixed glass feature bay, no extra doorway. WEST wall has one tea conversation alcove centred y1 with one small table and two armchairs. One display sideboard stands on west wall toward southwest. A pair of floral pedestals stands at northeast. No other dining tables or duplicate alcoves. One chandelier above the oval table. Three shallow pointed ceiling bays have indigo star fields, ivory ribs and gilt bosses. Lower wall dado and carved cornice4.5m, clerestory above. Maintain connected circulation1.8m around the dining group and to every doorway.
A: SOUTH ENTRY LOOKING NORTH: central table toward north apse, east windows on right, west tea alcove on left. B: NORTH APSE LOOKING SOUTH: entry behind table; east windows must appear on LEFT and west tea alcove and southwest sideboard on RIGHT. DO NOT SWAP corner furniture when reversing camera. C: WEST LOOKING EAST: three east window bays opposite, north apse at LEFT edge, south entry at RIGHT edge. D: HIGH CORNER CUTAWAY: same plan, remove near wall and lift half ceiling to show decorated underside; all8 chairs remain around one table. Small PLAN labelled N/E/S/W is the placement authority. Four view letters are not four assets; room ID INT-R03-S01.
Warm, dense but tidy celebration dressing: pink/cream floral centrepiece, eight coherent place settings, source-style crystal lamps, rose garlands over entry, paired gold wall sconces, indigo/blush curtains, rose carpet under dining group, matching small tea-zone rug, a closed gift grouping on sideboard and modest star ribbons. No beds, throne, musicians, food kitchen, giant cake or fountains. Let ornate marble wall panels, arch soffits, gold cornices and ceiling remain readable. Furniture does not merge into wall carving. Neutral ivory board, crisp labels outside views. Include a ceiling underside detail and table section showing human height. Footer: Proposed room layout; image view parity, dimensions and joins require model review.

visual_review_notes: Four room views, a north-up plan and ceiling/detail studies are present. Blue/rose stained glass, rose/ivory marble and gold trim remain source-compatible. Dining salon itself is a proposed new room.

Views A/B retain opposite-side window placement and west tea alcove placement more clearly than the suite reverse view. Exact eight-chair count and every floral pedestal position are not independently verified.

Cutaway changes bay proportions and appears to have more seating than the declared plan. The saved proposed layout controls table dimensions and seating count; do not derive exact mesh coordinates from perspective images.
